title: rosa communis subsp. montana
intro: Rosa communis subsp. montana, commonly known as the Mountain Rose, is a species of wild rose native to the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Rosa communis subsp. montana include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe respiratory issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
